tokens.name: bg

tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Highlighted panels and callouts; never behind body copy longer than a paragraph.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg, surface, and surface-tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card edges. Not for anything that must be seen to be used.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; meets 3:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the one main call to action. The fill measures 2.7:1 against bg in light, so a button is identified by its label and, in forced colors, its transparent border.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and action-hover.

tokens.name: link

tokens.name: highlight

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on highlight.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus outline; 3:1 or more on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page, the hero headline. Fluid: clamp(2.441rem, 1.749rem + 3.075vw, 4.209rem) (39px on phones, 67px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: heading-xl
styles.usage: Page titles (h1). Fluid: clamp(1.953rem, 1.482rem + 2.094vw, 3.157rem) (31px on phones, 51px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Section headings (h2). Fluid: clamp(1.563rem, 1.248rem + 1.402vw, 2.369rem) (25px on phones, 38px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Subsections and card titles (h3). Fluid: clamp(1.25rem, 1.044rem + 0.917vw, 1.777rem) (20px on phones, 28px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Small headings (h4) and dialog titles. Fluid: clamp(1.125rem, 1.044rem + 0.362vw, 1.333rem) (18px on phones, 21px on wide screens). The size shown is the widest-screen size.

styles.name: label

spacing.note: A 4px grid written in rem: space-N = N × 0.25rem, the same scale as Tailwind's spacing utilities (gap-6 = space-6 = 1.5rem).

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: 0px at default size. No space.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px at default size. Hairline gaps: icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px at default size. Tight gaps inside chips and button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px at default size. Input and small-button inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px at default size. Default gap between related items; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 20px at default size. Card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px at default size. Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-10

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: space-32

shadow.note: Shadows are tinted with espresso, never neutral gray. Hot dog mode swaps them for hard offset shadows. Forced-colors mode removes shadows, so never rely on one to show state.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs at rest, if raised.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards on hover, popovers, menus.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and drawers.

size.note: Component and layout sizes, in rem so they scale with the reader's font size.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (44px). Every clickable thing is at least this tall and wide, padding included.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs in dense app UI; pad the hit area to target-min.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg

tokens.name: icon-sm

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size, beside body text and in buttons.

tokens.name: choice
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio box size (24px). The label, or a hit-area pseudo-element, brings the target to target-min.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text (about 65 characters).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content.

borderWidth.note: Pixel values on purpose: hairlines should stay crisp, not grow with font size.
